notes.title: 《召唤与合体》2021年重做版更新公告
notes.content:
根据大量忠实玩家和积极反馈问题的玩家的意见，召唤与合体于2020年12月上线后开始了重新制作的企划。

将原本3D画面改为了2D像素画面，并将原本的玩法流程进行了重做大改。

推出了新的随机队伍功能和对抗道具功能，同时将游戏做成了多人对抗模式。

我们力求将游戏逐渐做的更有趣，更完善，后续还会逐渐更新内容和玩法。

本次更新后，因为时间和金钱的问题，我们只更新了9个角色，后续更新陆续会补充新的角色加入战斗。

游戏还在初期开发阶段，还希望得到喜欢这个游戏的玩家反馈，也希望大家加群反馈给开发组，让游戏逐渐变得更好。

虽然选择是艰难的，制作却是开心的，只要还有一个喜欢这个游戏的玩家玩，我们便会一直制作下去！

欢迎加入官方Q群：964307939，期待您的加入！

notes.title: 《Summon&Fusion》Notice of Renewal and Extension
notes.content:
According to the feedback of most players, the summon and Fit will be completely updated
There will be a big update to the game in the official (non-R18) direction

Inclusion is not limited to:
1. Reset the game screen
2. Reset the gameplay process of the stand-alone part
3. Produced some PVP functions, including 1V1 and multiplayer
4. Reset skills on the basis of the original 13 roles. Reset 9 roles for the first time, and then update 15 more roles
5. Add two new counter features to combat
6. Double the number of skill cards

It's all about making games more interesting based on feedback

I hope you can understand and give us continuous feedback

Specific update time to be determined

Here are the resets of some of the roles in the new screen

notes.title: Summon&Fusion Preupdate notice
notes.content:
Completely completely overhauling and Summon&Fusion was completely overhauling, which made sense. The game was completely early, but we were completely looking for customer feedback, not completely completely talking out of the way, and we'd completely change the completely completely later based on most of the customer feedback.


The expected changes are as follows:

1. Reset the overall picture of the game
2. Optimize the overall game performance
3. Add interesting character skills
4. Add more skill cards
5. Add more BOSS skills

If there is any follow-up content you want and any game problems you want to fix, please support us and post them in chat rooms or Q groups. We will try our best to satisfy all players' feedback.

The game will enter the overall optimization period, which is expected to last 2-4 weeks.
At the end of the optimization period, the game will usher in a big update and the official version of the online.

notes.content:
